state.seed_assertion: The nature of processing in a DPIA should include details about data collection, storage, usage, access, sharing, processors, retention periods, security measures, new technologies, and novel processing types.

sentences.1: It provides written advice to the controller and, where applicable to the processor within period of up to eight weeks of receipt of the request for consultation.
sentences.2: Controllers must submit the DPIA, documentation of responsibilities between controllers and processors, processing purposes and means, protective measures and safeguards, and DPO contact details when seeking prior consultation.
sentences.3: A DPIA must include a systematic description of the processing including nature, scope, context, personal data concerned, recipients, retention period, and identification of assets.
sentences.4: But, this also means that any processing operations where the conditions (scope, purposes, personal data collected, identity of data controllers or recipients, data retention period, technical and organizational measures, etc.) have changed since the authorization was issued by the CNPD and are likely to result in a high risk, require a DPIA.
sentences.5: The DPC will respond to a submission for statutory prior consultation within a period of up to eight weeks, where it appears that the intended processing would infringe the provisions of the GDPR or Data Protection Act, or that the controller has insufficiently identified or mitigated the potential risks.
sentences.6: The DPC response period may be extended by up to six weeks to account for the complexity of the proposed processing.
sentences.7: The period for responding may be extended by a period of up to six weeks, taking into account the complexity of the proposed processing.
sentences.8: That period may be extended by six weeks, taking into account the complexity of the intended processing.
